title: Morning arrivals at Harlow Tower
question: Where does the 8:30 arrival peak jam: the revolving doors, the turnstile banks or the elevators, and which cheap change clears it fastest?
context: Weekday morning at Harlow Tower, a 24-floor office building. People walk in from the street, the subway concourse and the garage, badge through turnstiles, then ride the elevators or take the stairs to their floor.

archetypes.name: Subway commuters
archetypes.description: Arrive in waves each time a train pulls in; know the building well.

archetypes.name: Walk-ins from Main St
archetypes.description: Walk or ride the bus in; most come through the revolving doors.

archetypes.name: Garage parkers
archetypes.description: Park on P1 and can badge straight in at the garage shuttle elevator.

archetypes.name: Visitors and couriers
archetypes.description: Do not know the building; follow the signs and the crowd.

minds.name: Maya Chen
minds.bio: Law firm associate on floor 21; the partners notice who is late to the 8:45 meeting.
minds.social: checks the building app's elevator wait screen

minds.name: Carlos Ruiz
minds.bio: Facilities supervisor on floor 3 who takes the stairs on principle.
minds.goal: Never wait for an elevator to go three floors
minds.social: hears security's radio chatter about the lobby

minds.name: Tyrone Jackson
minds.bio: Mailroom clerk on floor 2 whose shift starts at 8:00 sharp.

minds.name: Elena Petrova
minds.bio: Consultant on floor 15, already on a client call through her earbuds.
minds.goal: Keep the call going and get upstairs
minds.social: nobody; she is on a call

minds.name: Brian O'Connor
minds.bio: Senior accountant on floor 18 with a bad knee.
minds.goal: Same turnstile, same elevator, every day
minds.social: the security guard tells him which side is moving

minds.name: Fatima Zahra
minds.bio: Junior designer on floor 9 who grabs coffee on the way and runs late.
minds.social: follows coworkers she spots in the lobby

minds.name: Raj Malhotra
minds.bio: Bank analyst on floor 20 who bikes in and must be online before the market opens.
minds.social: a Slack channel where colleagues post the elevator line

minds.name: Nina Alvarez
minds.bio: Marketing manager on floor 10, seven months pregnant.
minds.goal: A calm ride, never a packed car or the stairs
minds.social: a coworker meets her in the lobby

minds.name: Daniel Kim
minds.bio: Startup CTO on floor 23 who parks on P1 and swears by the garage shuttle elevator.
minds.goal: The fastest path to his floor

minds.name: Sarah Goldberg
minds.bio: HR director on floor 6 carrying a box of files from her car.
minds.goal: Avoid stairs while carrying the box
minds.social: her assistant texts her if the lobby is packed

minds.name: Grace Thompson
minds.bio: Job candidate interviewing on floor 11 at 9:00; first time in the building.
minds.goal: Find the right elevator and not be late
minds.social: follows the lobby signs and asks the guard

minds.name: Leo Martins
minds.bio: Courier delivering a package to floor 22, paid per drop.
minds.goal: Drop the package and leave in under ten minutes
